test_error_registry_lifecycle: test the ErrorRegistry record, get, clear, and close methods for caching step errors
test_step_error_caching_and_retry: test that failing steps cache errors and retry mode clears cache to recompute
test_partial_error_state_self_heals: test that missing registry row or error pickle triggers automatic recompute instead of trapping
test_writer_overwrites_stale_pickle: test that a new failure overwrites a stale error pickle from a crashed prior run
test_clear_cache_partial_failure_leaves_: test that a crash during clear_cache wipes error indicators first to prevent phantom cached errors
